patch_description: Proposed improvement: replace the ring entanglement from CZ gates to a ring of CRX gates with a single shared parameter. This adds nonlinearity and richer entangling dynamics while keeping parameter budget small due to shared keys. The hub entanglement remains using CRZ and CRX gates with a single shared “hub_angle” parameter, preserving parameter efficiency and symmetry. This change aims to improve validation/test accuracy and reduce overfitting by increasing expressivity without increasing the total parameter count. The rest of the training loop, data construction, and metrics collection remain unchanged.
